content.short: Argentine money calculator tracking the official, blue and MEP dollar alongside USDT prices.
content.description: Argiefy was built for Argentines deciding how to pay, save or convert. It shows the official, blue, MEP and card dollar rates next to the USDT price, along with inflation and country risk, and its calculator compares instalments and conversions across cards and wallets. Guides cover questions like cashing out WLD to a local bank account, and World App users can open the calculator without leaving their wallet.
content.meta: Compare Argentina's official, blue and MEP dollar rates with USDT, and work out the cheapest way to pay or convert, in World App too.
